{
  "robot-walk-correction": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference animation into a production sprite strip. Complete SIX frame walk cycle: left foot forward contact right behind; left support with right foot passing underneath; right foot forward contact left behind; right support with left passing underneath; left forward approaching contact; left contact settling. Alternate dominant legs clearly. Arms counter swing, torso transfers weight. No identical leg phase in adjacent frames. Preserve EXACT character identity, palette, proportions, hand-painted shaded textured toy art of reference. SIX separate full-body frames arranged THREE columns TWO rows, chronological left to right top to bottom. Equal generous cells and transparent gaps. Same character size, angle, ground baseline per cell. Entire limbs fit each cell. Genuine alpha transparent background. No labels scenery shadows or effects. Only requested animation.",
  "front-charge-correction": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frames Front Charge: neutral; chassis squashed down and tilted forward storing momentum; maximally compressed anticipation; explosive forward projection with nose lowered and wagon stretched behind; deceleration tilted back; return neutral. Clear aggressive ram without ANY dust or motion effects. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "rocket-punch-correction": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frames Rocket Punch: neutral guard; draw fist back with torso rotation; fist shoots forward with short mechanical extensible linkage; full forward punch extension and torso lean; fist retracts and torso recovers; neutral. Body complete in every frame. Match soft painterly contour of reference, NO thick black vector outlines. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "steam-blast-correction": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frames Steam Blast BODY ONLY without steam: neutral; boiler/chassis compress under pressure; engine strains and chimney angles toward forward emission; chassis recoils backward as chimney thrusts forward to vent; settles from recoil; neutral. Strong anticipation of expelling pressure without clouds or effects. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "laser-beam-correction": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frames Laser Beam BODY ONLY without laser or glow: neutral; arms lift outward exposing emitter face; torso braces and head visibly aims right; locks torso with widened feet and head leans forward for firing; recoils slightly backward maintaining aim; lowers arms neutral. Clearly preparing ranged emission distinct from punch. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "train-walk-review": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frame mechanically correct rolling cycle, stable intact blue red green train: rotate wheel crank pins through 0,60,120,180,240,300 degrees; rigid connecting rod joins crank pins synchronized same angle on linked wheels. Spokes visibly rotate. Chassis slight cyclic bounce. No dust no effects. Last phase flows into first. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "dinosaur-rush-review": "Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference into a production animation sprite sheet. SIX frames Rush: neutral; crouch and tuck head with jaw CLOSED; load hind legs while forward leaning; launch body horizontal with long stretched leg drive and jaw CLOSED; plant legs and brake with weight back; return neutral. Show whole-body charge not neck/jaw bite. Preserve toy proportions. Preserve EXACT identity palette proportions and soft hand-painted shaded textured toy illustration of reference. SIX distinct full-body frames THREE columns TWO rows chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Equal generous cells transparent gaps. Same body size, ground baseline and perspective. Every limb and extension entirely inside own cell. Transparent alpha background. No labels scenery shadows or special effects. No thick black vector outlines. Only requested animation.",
  "robot-walk-retry": "Correct ONLY walk leg phasing and contour style of reference robot. Six full-body poses 3 columns 2 rows. Frames 1 and 4 MUST be OPPOSITE leg contacts: frame1 NEAR leg forward FAR leg backward; frame4 FAR leg forward NEAR leg backward. Frame2 NEAR leg supporting while FAR knee swings forward; frame3 legs crossing; frame5 FAR leg supporting while NEAR knee swings forward; frame6 legs crossing returning to frame1. Arms counterrotate with opposite legs. No repeated near-leg-forward stride in every cell. Preserve original soft painted robot silhouette and proportions, NO heavy black cartoon strokes. Clean transparent alpha background, no colored halo effects no floor no text. Match reference art. Six isolated complete robot drawings same size and generous margins.",
  "robot-walk-final": "Use case identity-preserve. Match the existing soft painterly toy robot. Produce FOUR complete walking poses 2 columns 2 rows as a seamless four-frame walk cycle. Top-left: LEFT leg steps forward and RIGHT leg back, left arm back right arm forward. Top-right: RIGHT leg passes under torso while LEFT supports. Bottom-left: RIGHT leg now steps forward and LEFT leg behind, right arm back left arm forward. Bottom-right: LEFT leg passes under torso while RIGHT supports. CRITICAL bottom-left must show opposite leg ahead from top-left, not same stride again. Distinct foreground and background leg poses and opposing arm swings. Keep identity teal tin red gloves red soles gold face windup key unchanged. Use soft painted thin edges, NOT black cartoon outlines. Same body size and baseline. Full bodies isolated with ample margins, genuine transparent alpha background, no backdrop halo no floor no effects no text."
}
